_comment: Narrowed planar-fault defect labels (C14/C15 stacking view). C36 is treated as a repeating C14+C15 compound; atoms are labeled only where the sequence deviates from pure C14 or C15 stacking. XY' is C14 and therefore has no defect atoms. Composition-independent: keyed by the stack-sequence part of A-B_<stack> folder names. Values are 1-based LAMMPS/OVITO atom ids.
_rationale: Originally Laves phase has three polytypes: C14, C15, and C36. Treating C36 as C14+C15+C14+C15+... means only deviations from C14/C15 stacking are marked as defects.
